originalTitle: Nvidia’s $500 billion plan envelops Wall Street in its AI frenzy
simplifiedContent: Nvidia, a big tech company, has announced a plan to help other companies that work with artificial intelligence (AI) by giving them access to a lot of money - $500 billion. They're working with big banks to lend money to startups that make AI computer chips. This plan is meant to help these startups because they need a lot of computing power to develop their AI products. The goal is to support the growth of the tech industry, specifically in the area of AI, by giving these companies the funding they need to build the necessary infrastructure. This matters because it could help the tech industry develop and innovate faster, which could be exciting for investors like you.

originalTitle: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
simplifiedContent: Alphabet, the company that owns Google, made a big investment in SpaceX about 10 years ago, putting in $900 million. That investment is now worth about $94 billion, which is a huge return. This means Alphabet's original investment grew 100 times in value, making it the largest shareholder in SpaceX. Other investors, like Fidelity and Saudi Arabia's investment fund, also own significant parts of the company. This matters because it shows how a smart investment can lead to enormous gains over time.

originalTitle: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
simplifiedContent: Patanjali Foods, a company listed on the stock market, has announced its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it made, increased by 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore. Its gross profit, which is the amount of money it made after subtracting its costs, also increased by 35.22% to ₹1,521 crore. This growth is significant because it shows that the company is performing well and making more money than it did last year. The company is also sharing some of its profits with its shareholders in the form of two interim dividends, which is a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Dollar falls on surprise drop in US retail sales
simplifiedContent: The value of the US dollar has gone down because of a surprise decrease in the amount of things people are buying in stores in the US. This decrease in retail sales was not expected, which means it caught investors off guard. As a result, the dollar's value fell compared to other currencies. This matters because a weaker dollar can affect the overall US economy and potentially impact investments. The drop in retail sales and the falling dollar value are significant events that investors are paying attention to.

originalTitle: Patanjali Foods shares to be in focus on Monday as Q1 net profit jumps 86%; revenue hits record
simplifiedContent: Patanjali Foods had a very good quarter, with their profit increasing by 86% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹335.73 crore. They also had their highest-ever revenue of ₹11,337.45 crore. This means the company made more money than ever before. The company's shares will likely be closely watched on Monday because of this good news. The company has also decided to give its shareholders a 40% dividend, which is a portion of the company's profit paid out to shareholders.

originalTitle: Alphabet's $900 million SpaceX bet soars to $94 billion after rocket firm's IPO, filings show
simplifiedContent: Alphabet, the company that owns Google, invested $900 million in a company called SpaceX a while back. Recently, SpaceX had an Initial Public Offering (IPO), which is when a company starts selling its shares to the public. After the IPO, it was found that Alphabet's investment is now worth around $94 billion, which is a huge increase. This makes Alphabet the largest institutional holder of SpaceX, meaning they own the most shares among big investors. This is significant because it shows that Alphabet's investment in SpaceX has been very successful and has grown greatly in value.
